caption: A photorealistic film still from a contemporary Chinese university romance short drama, cinematic live-action realism, square 1:1 image with 1024x1024 framing. Rich but natural skin texture, believable hands, fabrics and practical light, emotionally restrained acting, carefully staged subjects, no text, subtitles, logos or watermarks. Gu Xi is a 20-year-old Chinese female art student with long straight black hair, naturally expressive eyes, cream cardigan over white shirt and light blue jeans. Jiang Jin is a 22-year-old Chinese male computer science student with short neat black hair, charcoal jacket over white T-shirt, reserved face and a subtle old scar near his left wrist. Zhou Qian is a Chinese female student aged 21 with long wavy dark hair and powder blue outfit. H University digital art festival takes place in a real modern campus exhibition laboratory with a giant blue-violet LED display and realistic equipment. In front of the malfunctioning exhibit, Gu Xi holds her drawing tablet, visibly concerned but composed, while a worried campus event technician in plain student staff clothing points at the broken screen. Zhou Qian stands just behind them with a thin mocking smile, watching Gu Xi instead of the screen. Three-person medium shot with the glitching violet installation behind, distinct natural faces and restrained realistic expressions.
